tasks.title: Establish purpose and review preferences
tasks.completion_evidence: User confirms a primary use case and what a useful result looks like; review preference recorded.

tasks.title: Agree on workspace, source scope, and permissions
tasks.completion_evidence: Exact root is verified empty or absent; its creation/use, a per-source access plan with explicit in/out boundaries, local writes/retention, exclusions, action gates, and recovery responsibility are confirmed.

tasks.title: Establish the fixed starter structure
tasks.completion_evidence: Empty-root precondition rechecked immediately before bootstrap; required directories/files and seven templates created without overwriting; contracts recorded; any user-requested deviations approved.

tasks.title: Verify the selected source path
tasks.completion_evidence: Selected connector/MCP's account, relevant callable read tools, and one bounded authorized read verified, or a supplied local file is readable. Record unavailable capabilities and read/write exposure. Configuration alone is not proof; connector changes require separate approval.

tasks.title: Implement and test the ingest procedure
tasks.completion_evidence: Duplicate-input, changed-version, and interrupted-operation tests pass with safe fixtures; processing states and provenance rules documented.

tasks.title: Implement session-start sweep and triage
tasks.completion_evidence: Fixture cases for processed, pending, superseded, skipped, and blocked work are classified correctly without unintended writes.

tasks.title: Establish evidence-backed queries and briefs
tasks.completion_evidence: A known-answer query cites evidence; an unknown/conflicting-answer case preserves uncertainty; a meeting brief distinguishes invitees from attendance.

tasks.title: Establish report-only validation
tasks.completion_evidence: Metadata, duplicate identity, links, provenance, integrity, and backlog checks report fixture defects without silently repairing them.

tasks.title: Seed the primary work context
tasks.completion_evidence: User confirms the focus; actual terminology and authoritative sources are recorded; unknown or disputed deadlines remain explicit.

tasks.title: Approve a bounded pilot
tasks.completion_evidence: Source selection and expected output are confirmed, or selection is explicitly delegated within scope.

tasks.title: Execute and review the pilot
tasks.completion_evidence: Source handled under the completed procedure; synthesis linked and validated; user accepts or requests specific changes.

tasks.title: Exercise the integrated manual workflow
tasks.completion_evidence: Re-run causes no duplicates; resume works; queries and validation behave as designed; fresh startup finds rules and next state.

tasks.title: Verify recovery, if selected
tasks.completion_evidence: Restore into a separately approved test location preserves source hashes and useful notes. No backup destination is assumed.

tasks.title: Agree on ongoing operating mode
tasks.completion_evidence: User selects manual-only or a defined automation proposal. Limits and recovery status are explicit; proposals are not enabled jobs.

tasks.title: Authorize and test automation, if selected

conditional_dependencies.display: S13 if recovery verification was made a requirement

tasks.completion_evidence: Exact configuration approved; dry run, duplicate suppression, overlap guard, checkpointing, and failure reporting tested; first enabled run verified.

tasks.title: Handoff and readiness statement
tasks.completion_evidence: User sees actual completed scope, unresolved/deferred items, source limitations, and how to resume, pause, or revoke authorization.
